components.name: method
values: mosaic platform | spheroids of mixed cancer cell lines are cultured in suspension treated with drugs or dmso for 24 hours dissociated fixed and profiled using the parse gigalab kit. libraries prepared with combinatorial barcoding and sequencing adapters. cell line identity deconvolved using detected snps.

scrna-seq data processing | raw sequencing reads processed with vevo s filtering criteria. cells passed minimal filters 100.6 million and full filters 95.6 million . downstream analyses used the full-filtered set.

components.name: task
values: culture of spheroids consisting of 50 cancer cell lines in suspension drug treatment for 24 hours dissociation fixation and scrna-seq using parse gigalab kit.
sequencing of 1 786 sublibraries from 14 96-well plates to obtain 1.4 trillion raw reads representing 153 million cells.
snp-based deconvolution to assign cells to cell line of origin.
